title: Go On & Go Through
situation: Troubleshooting a machine problem until it works again.
objective: Use go on and go through to talk about continuing and following steps.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When I have a problem, I don't give up easily.
dialogue.indonesian: Ketika menghadapi masalah, saya tidak mudah menyerah.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I keep going and try to find the cause.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya terus berusaha dan mencoba menemukan penyebabnya.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Sometimes I need to go through several troubleshooting steps before I find the problem.
dialogue.indonesian: Terkadang saya harus melalui beberapa langkah troubleshooting sebelum menemukan masalah.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Even if it takes time, I want to do my best and get the machine working again.
dialogue.indonesian: Meskipun membutuhkan waktu, saya ingin melakukan yang terbaik dan membuat mesin berfungsi kembali.

learningNotes: go on berarti terus berlanjut atau melanjutkan.
go through berarti menjalani atau melewati serangkaian langkah.
do my best berarti melakukan yang terbaik; get the machine working again berarti membuat mesin berfungsi kembali.
